records.quote:
There had been too many giant steps, too fast. He had seen this thing in
the faces of men before, but never so nakedly.
records.paraphrase: The General senses that humanity has advanced too fast and must retreat.

records.quote: "Tell me _why_."
records.paraphrase: Johnny demands an explanation for the aliens' motives as a condition of belief.

records.quote:
It was the Earth that men had
intended, rather than that which they had built.
records.paraphrase: A dream shows an idealized version of Earth as humanity intended it.

records.quote:
Their weapon is knowledge, but
the potentialities of that knowledge must be understood by a people
before it can be effectively used to destroy them.
records.paraphrase: The invaders use gifted knowledge as a weapon that destroys advanced civilizations.

records.quote:
Space-flight requires but a relative minimum of those things, Earthman.
Required most is psychological and philosophical conditioning.
records.paraphrase: The aliens argue that spaceflight demands psychological, not just physical, preparation.

records.quote:
If your friends return
successfully to your planet with that 'gift'--then--
records.paraphrase: The other crews carrying the alien 'gift' home would doom Earth.

records.quote:
You had thought our planet lifeless; it was an
error. We live underground, John Love. That is why you did not see us,
or surface indications of our existence.
records.paraphrase: A supposedly dead Mars is revealed to hold an underground living civilization.

records.quote:
Then Johnny Love was on his feet again, and the sand clutched at his
heavy boots as though to keep him from leaving Ferris and the ship
records.paraphrase: Johnny surviving alone on the Martian surface after the crash.

records.quote: Skeletons, reaching upward to a puffy, leaden sky.
records.paraphrase: A vision depicts Earth reduced to devastation and death.

records.quote:
A man didn't complete the first
Earth-Mars flight ever made, smash his ship to hell, and then just walk
away from it.
records.paraphrase: The protagonist has traveled to Mars on the first Earth-Mars flight.

records.quote:
Until there was no trust left on all the planet.

There were the wars, then.
records.paraphrase: The gifted knowledge led to distrust and planet-wide war on Mars.

records.quote:
They can make a man 'dream,' as you did--or they can destroy him
outright, depending on which of the 'psi' factors, ESP or PK, is given
dominance during projection.
records.paraphrase: The device can induce dreams or kill depending on which psi factor dominates.

records.quote:
With this instrument, they have succeeded in
taking one of Nature's more subtle phenomenon--psychokinesis--and
amplifying its energies nearly a million-fold. Those stepped-up energies
can then be projected in a tight or fanned beam at will.
records.paraphrase: The psibeam device amplifies psychokinetic energy and projects it as a beam.
The mission plan specifies staggered crews and contingency conditions for the long interplanetary journey.

records.quote:
Once your blast-off ogee had
carried you beyond the curvature of their horizon and brought you over
us, our psibeam was effective and theirs were not.
records.paraphrase: The psibeam's effectiveness depends on line of sight over the planetary curvature.

records.quote: "Damn you! God damn you, what are you going to do to me?"
records.paraphrase: Johnny reacts with fear and anger to his alien captors.

records.quote:
Perhaps at this point you should be informed that your ship is
completely repaired, and ready for your return to Earth whenever you
desire.
records.paraphrase: The aliens have fully repaired Johnny's wrecked ship in days.

records.quote:
We wish to give you data to take back to your Earth which will banish
disease for you--_all_ disease. Data which will give you spacecraft that
match our own in technical perfection.
records.paraphrase: The aliens offer advanced scientific data to Earth.

records.quote:
A psibeam unit is
unaccounted for, and despite our protective screening, the Earthman was
visibly disturbed in his sleep.
records.paraphrase: The Martians describe a stolen psibeam device affecting the human's mind despite their screening.

records.quote:
You sound too damned much like a
politician.
records.paraphrase: Johnny is suspicious of the aliens' overly generous offer.

records.quote:
A group of us speak your
language, because for eleven days we have been studying your brain and
analyzing your thought-patterns.
records.paraphrase: The aliens explain they learned English by analyzing the human's brain over eleven days.

records.quote: I can figure 'em," he said. "I know blast-off schedules, speeds. I know the works!
records.paraphrase: Johnny volunteers his mission knowledge to help destroy the returning crews.

records.quote:
After we destroyed ourselves, they sank
their infectious, hollow roots into our planet.
records.paraphrase: The Martian civilization destroyed itself and was taken over by the invaders.

criteria.rationale: The psibeam draws on psychokinesis and ESP/PK 'psi' phenomena, explicitly treated as one of Nature's phenomena amplified a million-fold, a speculative-science premise materially represented.
The psibeam device is the engineered invention that drives the plot: it induces Johnny's dreams, forces his ship down, and becomes the weapon he offers to use against the returning crews.
The story is set in a speculative future with the first Earth-Mars flight and a 273-day interplanetary voyage, materially framing the setting.

The premise that gifted advanced knowledge, weaponized through distrust, destroys a civilization is developed into consequences on Mars and the impending doom threatening Earth via the returning crews.

The Martians analyze Johnny's brain over eleven days and read encephalotapes, and Johnny demands causal explanation before belief; these gesture at systematic inference, but generic investigation/questioning does not clearly amount to hypothesis-testing driving the plot.
The entire story unfolds on Mars with an underground Martian civilization and out-System invaders from Aldebaran, a nonordinary cosmic setting with alien visitors.
Planet-wide war destroyed the Martian civilization, and an analogous large-scale catastrophe impends over Earth if the invaders' 'gift' reaches it, causally central to the plot.

candidates.description: The psibeam: a device that amplifies psychokinesis nearly a million-fold and projects ESP/PK energies as a beam, capable of inducing controlled dreams/visions, compelling behavior, or killing outright depending on which psi factor dominates. Line-of-sight over planetary curvature governs its effectiveness.

novelty.rationale: The psibeam represents a totalizing difference from the empirical norm: an amplified psychokinetic technology that can invade, manipulate, and destroy minds at a distance, altering the balance of power across the solar system.

cognitive_validation.rationale: The story supplies a coherent, systematic, nonsupernatural account: a natural phenomenon (psychokinesis) amplified and projected as a beam, with operational rules (ESP vs PK dominance, curvature-limited line of sight, screening, overload risk). This is imaginary but internally consistent pseudoscience adequate for cognitive validation.

narrative_hegemony.rationale: The psibeam drives the whole plot: it produces Johnny's dreams, compels him to abort blast-off and return, is the invaders' primary weapon of conquest, and is what the true Martians steal to save him. Nearly every narrative turn is governed by its use.

estrangement.rationale: The device makes a mundane phenomenon (dreaming, doubt) into an externally imposed weapon, defamiliarizing the human sense of an autonomous mind and revealing that Johnny's very convictions were manipulated.

candidates.description: The invaders' strategy of conquest by 'gift': offering advanced knowledge (cure for all disease, perfect spacecraft, a thousand years of science) that a recipient civilization uses to destroy itself through mutual distrust and war, allowing the invaders to take over without direct military conquest.

novelty.rationale: Weaponized benevolence—knowledge as an instrument that destroys advanced civilizations from within—is a totalizing world-altering premise that reframes the entire interplanetary order and the meaning of Earth's first contact.

cognitive_validation.rationale: The mechanism is a coherent, immanent social/psychological logic: gifted knowledge whose potential must be understood before it can destroy; hoarding of knowledge breeds distrust; distrust breeds war; war leaves the planet open to the invaders. Nonsupernatural and systematically explained.

narrative_hegemony.rationale: This is the overriding narrative logic of the title and the whole story: the 'gift for Terra' is the danger the true Martians act to prevent, motivating Johnny's climactic choice to help destroy the returning crews and explaining the framing 'Condition Untenable' ending.

estrangement.rationale: The narrative inverts the reader's expectation that a gift of knowledge is progress, revealing generosity as the most effective weapon and estranging the assumption that scientific advancement equals safety.

candidates.description: A supposedly dead Mars secretly harbors a living underground civilization (the original Martians) plus off-System invaders who have colonized the planet.

novelty.rationale: The revelation that a planet believed lifeless holds an underground civilization overturns the empirical premise of the expedition and alters the storyworld fundamentally.

cognitive_validation.rationale: The account is coherent and nonsupernatural: they live underground so no surface indications were visible, and they learned English by analyzing the human brain. Internally consistent.

narrative_hegemony.rationale: The existence of hidden Martian inhabitants is the setting-level premise enabling every subsequent event, though it functions largely as the stage on which the knowledge-weapon and psibeam nova operate rather than as the governing logic itself.

estrangement.rationale: The dead-planet-that-is-alive reversal defamiliarizes the trope of Mars-as-barren, undercutting the confident empiricism of the human explorers.

candidates.description: The first crewed Earth-Mars flight, structured with staggered crews at twenty-day intervals and contingency plans (Condition Optimum/Limited/Untenable) for the 273-day journey.

novelty.rationale: Interplanetary crewed spaceflight is a difference from the present empirical norm, situating the story in an extrapolated near-future.

cognitive_validation.rationale: The mission is described in coherent, systematic engineering/procedural terms (staggered launches, journey duration, contingency plans), a plausible extrapolation.

narrative_hegemony.rationale: Spaceflight is the enabling backdrop and framing device rather than the governing narrative logic; the plot is driven by the psibeam and the knowledge-weapon, not by the flight itself. It is an incidental (if necessary) setting element.

estrangement.rationale: The routinized bureaucratic mission planning ('swivel-chair genius', Plan III) estranges heroic exploration into administrative procedure, but this remains scene-setting.
